Weibo: Narcissus Cinnamon Pro

————

Game Type: Suspense and Micro-Horror | AVG Visual Novel

Game Introduction: You wake up as a doctor in a mental hospital, entangled with three suspicious "patients" who appear by your side. Little by little, your past and memories are revealed...

Among the three male leads, one is a hidden character. Throughout the story, he wants to imprison you. Try to figure out who he is.

But he is not the only one with a captive ending.

Darkened, White Moonlight or Dropped from the Sky, Older or Younger, Love at First Sight or Can't Forget You After You Dumped Me, and More Tags Awaiting Your Discovery

Character Introduction:

The president's eldest son runs the company to great success, helps old ladies cross the road, and regularly donates to welfare institutions. I was dumped by you, but I still can't forget you.

Little brother, who works part-time at n jobs to support his studies and is very popular, has admired you for a long time. He deliberately got close to you and fell in love with you at first sight.

A great actor, a childhood sweetheart who grew up with you and has strong feelings for you

But not paying attention to the possibility of another personality?

Gameplay:

1. Multi-branch narrative, your destiny is up to you

Key choices affect the ending: Every dialogue choice and interaction in the game can change character relationships and the direction of the story, unlocking a completely different ending.

* Favorability system (demo version has not been implemented yet) : Different characters with different favorability will trigger different dialogue, hiding plot lines for further exploration.

2. Freely allocate action points

* Different fields (worlds) during the day and night, the setting of action points allows different choices or choices to collide with different plots or meet different people (multiple points in individual locations will also trigger different plots)

3. Memory fragments

* By collecting memory fragments and unlocking forgotten memories, character relationships gradually emerge...

-- -- --

Production group information:

Producer/Art: Daffodil Cinnamon

Copywriter: First quarter moon

Program outsourcing: Black pineapple
